title: [AAPS 3.0.0.1] Frequent pump unreachable errors with Orangelink and Emalink
symptom: Frequent pump unreachable errors with Orangelink and Emalink. The link disconnects from AAPS, sometimes it connects but fails to refresh, other times it stays in the initialization step.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It mentions that the connection to OL code was perfected and this problem was solved, but the issue persists. It also suggests that adaptive battery might be impacting Bluetooth, and that the app sometimes crashes leading to connection issues.
fix: The thread suggests following the Discord wiki instructions for restoring a dead connection, which involves shutting off the OrangeLink and force stopping AAPS, and doing steps in order. It also recommends stopping battery optimization for Bluetooth and trying an older firmware version (v2.5) for the OrangeLink. Simple restart of AndroidAPS also solves the issue.
evidence_quote: Actions decribed in wiki fopr 19.05.2021(!) (not 2020) indead fix the issue, I also noticed this early. I just thought that such things shouldn't happen or can happen very rarely. For me simple restart Android APS solves issue.
